question: Who is designated as the sacrificial animal within the Kula tradition?
premises: The subject is situated in the midst of the yogini group
He is identified as the animal
This designation is proclaimed in the Kula
inference: In the Kula, the one placed in the midst of the yogini group is called the animal.
uncertainties: Whether paśu is literal or symbolic is context-dependent.
plain_english: In the Kula, he who is situated in the midst of the group of yoginis is called the animal.
